projects.purpose: Reaper language, native tooling, policy contracts and explicit integration adapters
C11 compute/inspection ABI and read-only processor evidence
Read-only device, driver-package and GPU telemetry evidence
C++20 procedural audio, offline DSP and versioned sample-pack metadata

interfaces.boundary: Caller-owned bounded buffers; Reaper checks ABI version before loading a caller-selected trusted library. No ambient library discovery.
Reaper validates exact fields, read-only source mode, counters, bounds and canonical digest before comparison. Digest is integrity evidence, not a publisher signature.
DuckOS host inventory redacts device instance IDs per snapshot. Reaper performs read-only audit; no device or driver mutation.

The pinned OPlague source includes the v1 schema, read-only NVIDIA exporter and bridge documentation. The Reaper adapter accepts normalized records only after a trusted ingest layer validates the complete schema and canonical digest. Publisher/build attestation and AMD/Intel providers remain pending; this edge is not end-to-end trusted telemetry.

The VentuSample pack-v1 producer schema and audit document exist in the pinned VentuSample source. The pinned Reaper checkout has no pack consumer or the newer NEXUS federation profile document; treat the edge as metadata-only and specified-only.

shared_rules: Keep peer repositories as exact, independently versioned Git submodules; do not flatten or copy peer source trees.
Validate pinned source graph, licenses, interface artifacts and schema versions before integration.
Prefer versioned JSON for data exchange and narrow C ABI for synchronous compute; use IPC only after the DuckOS process model and syscall boundary are live.
Imported executables remain user-space programs, never kernel modules or privileged services.
Do not automatically load native libraries, run imported tools, install drivers or mutate devices.
OPlague and Pytyliki hardware evidence remains read-only; unknown telemetry values remain unknown.
VentuSample is offline-first; real-time audio requires a separately reviewed native audio service.
A policy adapter or schema is not an active production service; maturity labels require source and test evidence.
